No DeepSeek, Exa, or Perple"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"nothing but the Kimi API key you already use for chat. No DeepSeek, Exa, or Perplexity key required."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文文档"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What is this?"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"DSH's built-in `web_search` tool ships with three search providers (DeepSeek, Exa, Perplexity). If y"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ou run a Kimi model (e.g. `kimi-k3` through `moonshotai-cn`) but have no key for any of those provid"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ers, the tool is dead. This plugin closes the gap by speaking to Kimi's own Formula API — the offici"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"al-tools channel the Kimi platform recommends for `kimi-k3`:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"1. **A `ctx.web` search provider (`kimi-official`)** — plugs into DSH's web capability seam, so the "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"*built-in* `web_search` tool gains Kimi-native retrieval. Each search runs an auxiliary chat loop: t"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"he model declares the official `web_search` function tool, emits `tool_calls`, the plugin executes t"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"hem verbatim through `POST /formulas/moonshot/web-search:latest/fibers` (protected results arrive as"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" an encrypted envelope and are fed back untouched), and the model composes a cited answer. The answe"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"r is returned as `content`; `sources[]` is extracted from the links the model itself cites (Kimi exp"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"oses no structured result list to clients)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"2. **Ten model-facing `kimi_*` tools** — one per remaining official formula, each executing a fiber "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"call directly: `kimi_convert`, `kimi_date`, `kimi_base64_encode`, `kimi_base64_decode`, `kimi_random"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"_choice`, `kimi_memory`, `kimi_excel`, `kimi_fetch`, `kimi_rethink`, `kimi_mew`."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"> Kimi's docs also list `quickjs` and `code-runner`, but both currently answer `404 formula not foun"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"d` on `api.moonshot.cn`, so they are not registered. Re-run `node scripts/fetch-formula-tools.mjs` t"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"o check; adding them later is a two-line change in `src/formula-tools.js`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- A working DSH setup (the `web` profile — i.e. you run `dsh web`), Node.js ≥ 22.19.
- A Kimi API ke"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"y from platform.kimi.com. If you already configured a Moonshot provider on the DSH **Models** page, "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"the plugin reuses that very credential (`MOONSHOTAI_CN_API_KEY`) — nothing else to set up."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**One command** — pnpm (which `dsh plugin` forwards to) fetches straight from GitHub and installs th"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"e runtime dependencies automatically:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Alternative: install from a local clone (for development)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Edit the profile's user patch layer `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` (new modules cannot hot-load; profiles with `patchReload: live` apply the change o"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"n save without a restart)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Verify it works** — in a new session, ask:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"and"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-kimi-formula`, then delete the patch rows above."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"All fields are optional; the plugin installs a `kimi-formula` section under **Settings → Plugins** w"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"hen the settings service is present. You can also set them in the patch row's `config:` block."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Field | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| `apiKey` | — | Literal Kimi API key (prefer `apiKeyEnv`; never commit secrets) |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"MOONSHOTAI_CN_API_KEY` | Credential reference resolved per call. Matches what the Models page writes"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" for `moonshotai-cn`. Set to `MOONSHOT_API_KEY` if you only exported that one |
| `baseURL` | `https"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"://api.moonshot.cn/v1` | OpenAI-compatible base. Use `https://api.moonshot.ai/v1` for the internatio"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"nal platform; env override: `KIMI_FORMULA_BASE_URL` |
| `searchProvider` | `true` | Register the `ki"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"mi-official` ctx.web search provider |
| `searchModel` | `kimi-k3` | Model driving the auxiliary sea"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"rch loop |

| `searchMaxTokens` | `8192` | `max_tokens` per auxiliary request |
| `searchMax"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"Rounds` | `8` | Chat-round cap (initial + tool continuations) per search |
| `formulaTools` | `true`"},{"id":"p28s10","text":" | Register the `kimi_*` tools |
| `toolsTimeoutMs` | `60000` | Cooperative per-call budget for the "},{"id":"p28s11","text":" `kimi_*` tools |
